SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER , INV_NO , INV_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND WHERE REG_DATE BETWEEN SYSDATE-1 AND SYSDATE AND BUYER = 'KRFRLK0001' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PLANT , LEGACY_IV_NO , LEGACY_IV_SEQ , ATTR_01 AS LEGACY_PR_NO , ATTR_02 AS PARCEL_COST , STATUS , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , ITEM_QTY , INV_DATE , IF_FLAG , IF_DATE , IF_TIME FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
